text:
Predicates:
Animal(x) ::: x is an animal.
BredBack(x) ::: x is bred-back.
Resemble(x, y) ::: x resembles y.
Extinct(y) ::: y is extinct.
Question: ::: Is y extinct?

Premises:
HeckCattle(x) ∧ BredBack(x) ::: Heck cattle were bred-back in the 1920s.
HeckCattle(x) ::: Heck cattle are animals.
Aurochs(y) ::: Aurochs are animals.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ BredBack(x)) ::: Some animals are bred-back.
∃x (Animal(x) ∧ Resemble(x, y)) ::: Some animals to be bred-back resemble animals that are extinct.

Conclusion:
Extinct(y) ::: Aurochs are extinct.
